_README: OPTIMISTIC critical-path plan for the NR4A3 PROTAC-degrader paper (ChemRxiv preprint + JCIM).
This file is the SINGLE MACHINE SOURCE the daily status email projects into a day-by-day calendar.
HUMAN-READABLE MASTER (read this for the full rationale, GO/NO-GO gates + 'what's next'):
STRATEGY.md. Milestone `id`s here match the stage tags in that master plan.
Keep the two in sync: when work lands, update each milestone's `status` and, for an in-progress item,
`remaining_days`. `status`: done | in_progress | pending. `track`: gpu | cpu | write | submit.
`parallel_ok`: true = may overlap other legs up to the 8-wide spot quota. `cost_est_usd`: est. SPOT $ for
THAT step (honest range; pin tighter from realized GPU-h before launch).
2026-07-15 (trimcrae, after the reviewer verdict): SPEND-GATED LADDER + NO PRE-AUTHORIZATION.
(a) NOTHING is pre-authorized or staged to auto-launch. EVERY gpu run is presented at its gate with the
prior result + a pinned cost estimate, and waits for an explicit trimcrae 'go'. Only $0 CPU/CI runs
without a nod.
(b) The order is CHEAPEST-DECISIVE-FIRST: the cheapest run that could KILL the paper runs first, and each
rung's bigger spend is unlocked ONLY if the previous cheaper rung's result looks promising. We can kill
a non-viable paper for ~$25 (valA_mini) and never reach the ~$150-400 flagship matrix until four cheaper
gates have each said GO. See the master plan's Spend summary + GO/NO-GO tests.
RUNGS: 0 free/running (step0, emc_e3, pocket_reanalysis) -> 1 valA_mini (kill-switch) -> 2 step1_pilot +
valB_mini (all-binding graded edge) -> 3 valB_full CUBE + nrv04_feasibility -> 4 step1_fanout +
nr4a_differential_atlas($0) + nrv04_retrospective -> 5 ORIENTATION-FIRST LADDER: orientation_basin_search ->
selectivity_wedge_confirm (*** CAUSAL KILL-SWITCH: no confirmed NR4A3 wedge => STOP + publish negative) ->
inverse_linker_design($0) -> ternary_ensemble_refine -> local_ternary_fep -> 6 fold/redteam/post.
OPTIONAL/HELD: dg_open, abfe_conditional.
2026-07-24 RESTRUCTURING: RUNG 5 fixed {warhead x exit x ligase x linker} matrix REPLACED by an
orientation-first inverse-design ladder with a causal kill-switch (reciprocal alchemical mutation cycles).
Pilot-first kill-switch: atlas($0)+basin($0-50)+ONE pilot mutation leg. **BLOCKED + UNPRICED as of 2026-07-24:**
the mutation legs are PROTEIN-residue swaps (NR4A3->NR4A1), and this repo has no protein-mutation FEP engine -
OpenFE RHTP maps LIGAND atoms only, and the sole protein-mutation path (nr4a3_resistance_ddg.py) is MM-GBSA,
not alchemical. Every past price for this rung (~$40-90 pilot / ~$100-350 cycle, later ~$5-10 / ~$15-30)
assumed a capability that does not exist. Scope an engine before planning or pricing this rung; the wedge also
needs one CHARGE_METHOD pinned across its binary(am1bcc) and ternary(nagl) legs. Card: default everything on Vast
to the 4090 (measured $/ns winner at EVERY size, endpoint MD included). DO NOT quote a whole-program total (see
the 2026-07-24 CORRECTED economics note below + STRATEGY.md); price bottom-up per edge. STRATEGY.md authoritative.
The reviewer's 5 mandatory changes (verbatim: nr4a3-degrader-reviewer-revisions-2026-07-15.md):
(1) separate ACCURACY (public measured-ddG benchmark) vs PRECISION (cmpd19 = conditional hypotheses, no
pose) vs TERNARY known-answer control (VHL-BRD4/SMARCA2); NR-V04 -> biological HOLDOUT, not calibrator.
(2) cryptic-pocket affinities are CONDITIONAL (dG_bind|open); dG_open differs per paralogue -> part of
selectivity. Estimate dG_open per paralogue OR report conditional. Delete 'true binding likely stronger'.
(3) ABFE HELD/reframed: T4L is a smoke test not a transferable offset; report RAW; not proof of binding.
(4) NR-V04 celastrol is COVALENT (C551) -> covalent adduct + C551A + noncov/cov sensitivity + recruiter
controls; report DIRECTIONAL CONCORDANCE, never 'recovered degradation'.
(5) prospective matrix = staged gates + PARETO (not a tunable scalar); model EWSR1::NR4A3 fusion context +
lysines beyond the LBD + full CRL/E2~Ub ensembles; 24-36 before controls -> preregistered downselect.
LANGUAGE: 'predicted selective candidate'; never imply efficacy/safety/therapeutic-window/clinical-readiness;
cmpd19 MYC induction is a LIABILITY, not benefit.
2026-07-24 (CORRECTED Vast economics; supersedes a 2026-07-23 note): TWO findings. (1) CARD DECISION (measured,
solid): gpu_md_bench 4090=1549/669/175.6 vs 3090=72.5 ns/day at 35k/85k/444k -> the 4090 wins $/ns at EVERY
size INCLUDING the 466k covalent panel (2.42x the 3090, ~9% more/hr), refuting the a-priori 3090-for-covalent
pick (single-host-per-point; confirm before moving a large panel). (2) RETRACTION: a 2026-07-23 note claimed
the whole program is ~$80-200 on Vast 4090 by scaling PLAIN-MD bench throughput by ~1.7x - that retraction
stands. But the RBFE leg is now MEASURED on Vast 4090 and it is CHEAP; the old ~55-GPU-h AWS anchor is REFUTED
for this hardware. PROVENANCE (this session, 2026-07-24): the firm RBFE run was live-diagnosed on Vast instance
45654998 - OpenFE HREX complex leg (TYK2 valA, 12 windows, hardcoded 5 ns production) ran ~5.2 s/iter x 2000
production iters = ~2h52m sampler, + ~43 min boot/setup -> ~3.6 GPU-h billed at $0.122/hr (~$0.44); solvent leg
adds ~1.5-2 GPU-h. So RBFE binary edge (complex+solvent) ~5-6 GPU-h ~$0.6-1.4; step1_fanout(19) ~$12-26. The old
~55 GPU-h came from a 2026-07-13 AWS A10G leg that was ~65% GPU-IDLE (CPU-bottlenecked by 12x per-window am1bcc
re-charging, nr4a3-post-pilot-sequence.md); the Vast run charges once in setup -> ~15x fewer GPU-h. N_ITER does
NOT truncate production (nr4a3_rbfe.py:364-365 hardcodes 5 ns), so the earlier 'ran ~2h without finishing = 55
GPU-h' reading was WRONG - the leg was on track to finish at ~2h52m. Ternary 3-replica edge (146,509-particle,
**12**-window - CORRECTED 2026-07-24): PROJECTED, not measured. The valB_mini GCP L4 run gave a per-ITERATION
RATE (~33 s/iter; 'total wall 8:40:29' ~= 920 iters), and 920 iters is NOT a finished leg - the protocol hardcodes
1 ns equil + 5 ns prod at 2.5 ps/iter = 400+2000 = 2400 iters (nr4a3_rbfe.py:364-365), so that wall clock covered
~38% of a leg and the earlier ~$3-6/edge was ~2.6x LOW. Corrected: ~22 L4-GPU-h/leg -> x2 legs x3 replicas ~= ~132

L4-GPU-h -> / a SPEC-BASED (never benchmarked) ~2.3x L4->4090 ratio ~= **~$10-16 Vast 4090** (RECONCILED: their MEASURED 4090 rate ~14-18 s/iter x the corrected 2400-iter leg = ~10.7 GPU-h/leg -> ~64 GPU-h/edge)
(**~$94 as-run on L4 on-demand**). Caveats that must travel with it: NO ternary leg has ever run to completion, so
even the leg LENGTH is unverified; the L4->4090 card ratio is now MEASURED at ~2.06x (33 -> 16 s/iter, count-independent, so it survives the leg-length correction); window count is 12 not the 16 an
earlier note carried (gpu-ternary-fep-gcp.yml:29,70). Old $65-110 and $3-6 both superseded. Whole gated ladder now
totals ~$390 mid-range (~$170-610) on Vast 4090 for the PRICEABLE stages, GO at every gate, excl. optional/HELD
dg_open+ABFE (~$200-500 more) AND excl. the 5a-KS mutation wedge + reciprocal cycle, which are UNPRICED: OpenFE's
RelativeHybridTopologyProtocol maps LIGAND atoms only and the repo's sole protein-mutation path is non-alchemical
MM-GBSA endpoint scoring, so no engine exists (see selectivity_wedge_confirm.blocked_by). Swings, in order: the
unpriced wedge, the L4->4090 conversion, then ensemble-MD leg count (5c + retrospective).
Authoritative detail in STRATEGY.md -> economics block + research/compute/pricing.md (single source of truth).

2026-07-24 TERNARY-SELECTIVITY STRATEGY REVISION (research/manuscripts/nr4a3-ternary-selectivity-strategy-revision-2026-07-24.md; folded into STRATEGY.md, which stays authoritative). DIAGNOSIS: the prospective stage sought selectivity ONLY on the MARGINAL axis (an induced-interface free-energy difference). selectivity_margin_model.py: an 80%/20% degradation window needs ~2.0 kcal/mol of TRUE margin (median over 27 potency scenarios, 1.75-2.25) vs a best-case RESOLVABLE difference of 1.12 kcal/mol (replicate SD 0.7, n=3) and ~1.7 kcal/mol RMSE accuracy that does not even cover the NAGL ternary lane -> that axis is a CONFIRMATION tool at its limit, not a DISCOVERY tool. FIX: search CATEGORICAL axes first, where the paralogues are structurally incapable. nr4a_paralogue_unique_residues.py (full-length UniProt, dual-aligner agreement, run on CI): NR4A3 has 4 unique cysteines (C397 RSA 0.395 at 10.9 A from the cryptic pocket = exit-vector reach; C420; C559; C166 outside the LBD) and 4 unique lysines (K572 RSA 0.879, K518, K592 exposed at 11-16 A; K178 outside) that BOTH paralogues lack. At ZERO thermodynamic margin those give 0.82 (unique lysine) / 0.92 (covalent capture, kinetic form) on the window metric where the interface-only null gives 0.185. PRECEDENT: NR-V04, the field's one demonstrated NR4A-family-selective degrader, is most parsimoniously explained by a paralogue-unique cysteine (NR4A1 C551 -> NR4A3 T579, reproduced here) - filed until now only as a confound. CHECKED-AND-WEAK, reported not dropped: the EWSR1 fusion moiety contributes only 1-2 lysines (Lys-poor LC domain) -> fusion-lysine axis is thin, NOT a design axis. SIX COST LEVERS: (1) 4 fs ternary production ~2x cheaper/leg (runbook 1c: post-pre-equilibration calib ran production 40/40 at 4 fs, zero NaN; iterations are timestep-independent) - PROPOSED, settled by one ~$5-8 matched re-calibration edge; (2) the binary and solvent legs are PARALOGUE-INDEPENDENT so they cancel EXACTLY in any paralogue comparison -> a 3-paralogue panel is 3 ternary LEGS + 1 shared binary + 1 shared solvent, NOT 3 edges (valB_full module 3 and nrv04_retrospective were both priced as N edges); (3) sequential anytime-valid stopping via the already-built adaptive_certify.py, ~20-25%; (4) decouple the causal kill-switch from valB_full + nrv04_retrospective so the free gates lead; (5) the LIGAND-SIDE DOUBLE DIFFERENCE S = ddG_coop(d0->d|NR4A3) - ddG_coop(d0->d|NR4A1) becomes the PRIMARY causal test (ternary legs only, no protein-mutation engine, no cross-lane charge mismatch); the protein-mutation cycle is kept as a CONFIRMATORY second line, still UNPRICED; (6) E3 breadth is free at CPU search, capped at <=2 recruiters before any GPU. Ladder: ~$390 mid (~$170-610) -> ~$240 mid (~$90-390), with lower EXPECTED cost because the leading gates are $0. THREE DECISIONS PENDING A trimcrae GO: adopt 4 fs; swap the method calibrator to SMARCA2-vs-SMARCA4 (NR-V04 stays the biological holdout); demote the protein-mutation wedge to confirmatory.
spend_policy: NO pre-authorization. Every GPU run waits for an explicit go at its gate with a pinned cost. Cheapest-decisive-first: never spend an expensive rung unless the previous cheaper rung's result is promising.

milestones.note: ★ AS-RUN BASELINE VERIFIED AGAINST THE LIVE LANE, NOT THE DOC (2026-07-24 4:12 PM ET, GH run 30123894814 mode=tail reading VM gcp-ternary-30112102294): '[tfep] timestep=2.0 fs, minimization_steps=5000' and warmup_dt_override='WARMUP timestep overridden to 1.0 fs', NaN_seen=no, charge=nagl. So the lane really is 1 fs warmup -> 2 fs PRODUCTION; the '1 fs warmup + 4 fs production' shape is the runbook 1c PRE-EQUILIBRATION DEMONSTRATION (40 production iterations on calib), not this lane - and gpu-ternary-fep-gcp.yml defaults are timestep_fs=2.0 / use_preequil=0. EXACT INVOCATION for the adoption run, all three flags load-bearing: mode=preequil once (cached), then mode=run use_preequil=1 timestep_fs=4.0 warmup_timestep_fs=1.0 reset_commits=1. use_preequil=1 because 4 fs only held WITH pre-equilibration; reset_commits=1 because OpenFE refuses to resume a checkpoint whose protocol timestep differs ('Sampler in checkpoint does not match Protocol settings'), so a dt change starts CLEAN - a fresh edge, not a continuation, which is what the ~$5-8 already prices. 2026-07-24 revision, cost lever 1. EVIDENCE: ternary-rbfe-runbook.md 1c - after plain-MD pre-equilibration the calib ternary leg ran warmup 48/48 @1 fs -> production 40/40 @4 fs with ZERO NaN (dG_morph 47.28 +/- 0.53), where every prior attempt died at warmup iteration 1. The live valB lane nevertheless runs TIMESTEP_FS=2.0. Iterations are TIMESTEP-INDEPENDENT (2.5 ps/iter), so 4 fs is exactly half the force evaluations -> ternary edge ~$10-16 -> ~$5-8. CAVEAT THE RUNBOOK IMPOSES: validation and production must run at the SAME timestep, and the existing 4 fs evidence is 40 production iterations, not 2000. So: re-run the valB_mini Wurz edge at TIMESTEP_FS=4.0 with use_preequil=1. One edge, three jobs - (a) exercises 4 fs over a FULL 2000-iteration production leg, (b) supplies the matched-timestep calibration required before any 4 fs production number may be quoted, (c) is an independent reproducibility replicate of the 2 fs ddG_coop.
